objective: Test whether a leakage-free global M77 train-only K16 codebook transfers to the six exact-binary patch Conv3x3 modules and beats the strong one-source/96-lane bit-sparse reference.

catalog_policy.source: aggregate calibration_count over every pattern in the admitted M77 DSEC-train-only catalog
catalog_policy.selection: top 16 unique nonzero masks with deterministic count-descending/value-ascending order

source_geometry.source_partition: tap-major contiguous groups of 16 input channels

same_resource_cycle_model.bit_sparse_reference: one selected INT8 weight vector updates 96 destinations per cycle
same_resource_cycle_model.wide_pwp: one signed12 PWP or one INT8 correction vector updates 96 destinations per cycle
same_resource_cycle_model.shared96_pwp: PWP occupies two cycles on the same 96-byte path; correction occupies one
same_resource_cycle_model.tree_materializer: one 96-lane add/sub cycle per global-codebook MST flip
same_resource_cycle_model.input_scan_and_output_commit: charged serially and identically to all points

required_gates: all 60 payload SHAs and exact active-bit populations
M222 valid receptive-field source contribution equality per record
global catalog provenance and deterministic top16 identity
bit-sparse/PWP/correction work conservation per partition and aggregate
same scan, commit, weight-load, matcher, packer, tail and materialization recurrence
all ten samples and all six selected modules individually faster for performance admission

claim_boundary.admitted_if_pass: exact trace-driven six-patch-Conv isolated module-cycle opportunity with a disjoint train-only global catalog
not_admitted: RTL-integrated cycles, VCS, DC, SRAM macro, power, energy, complete patch embed, system speedup, paper PPA, or headline
the dense first patch head or PED shortcut outside the six exact-binary selected modules
